source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יוֹתָ֣ם בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְרוּשָׁ֖ה בַּת־צָדֽוֹק׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of twenty and five year[s] [was] Jotham when he became king, and six-teen year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Jerushah daughter of Zadok.

en.L: Jotham [was] twenty-five years old when he became king, and sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Jerushah daughter of Zadok.
en.B: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Jerushah daughter of Zadok.
en.R: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years. His mother was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

es.L: [Tenía] veinticinco años Jotam cuando comenzó a reinar, y dieciséis años reinó en Jerusalén; y el nombre de su madre [era] Jerusa hija de Sadoc.
es.B: Jotam tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó dieciséis años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Jerusa hija de Sadoc.
es.R: Jotam tenía veinticinco años cuando llegó a ser rey, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante dieciséis años. Su madre se llamaba Jerusa y era hija de Sadoc.

fr.L: Jotham [avait] vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Yerousha fille de Tsadoq.
fr.B: Jotham avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Yerousha, fille de Tsadoq.
fr.R: Jotham avait vingt-cinq ans quand il est devenu roi. Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant seize ans. Sa mère s’appelait Yerousha ; c’était la fille de Tsadoq.

sw.L: Yothamu [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, na miaka kumi na sita alitawala huko Yerusalemu; na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Yerusha binti Sadoki.
sw.B: Yothamu alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na sita huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Yerusha binti Sadoki.
sw.R: Yothamu alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na sita. Mama yake aliitwa Yerusha binti Sadoki.

vi.L: Giô-tham [được] hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì mười sáu năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ vua [là] Giê-ru-sa con gái Xa-đốc.
vi.B: Giô-tham được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười sáu năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-ru-sa con gái Xa-đốc.
vi.R: Giô-tham được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mười sáu năm. Mẹ vua tên là Giê-ru-sa, con gái Xa-đốc.

ko.L: 요담이 왕이 되었을 때 25세였고, 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 사독의 딸 여루사였다.
ko.B: 요담은 25세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 사독의 딸 여루사였다.
ko.R: 요담은 25세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 사독의 딸 여루사였다.

pt.L: Jotão tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e dezesseis anos reinou em Jerusalém; e o nome da sua mãe [era] Jerusa, filha de Zadoque.
pt.B: Jotão tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dezesseis anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Jerusa, filha de Zadoque.
pt.R: Jotão tinha vinte e cinco anos quando se tornou rei. Governou em Jerusalém durante dezesseis anos. A mãe dele era Jerusa, filha de Zadoque.

decisions.choice: the opening of Jotham's reign: parallel to 2 Kings 15:32-33
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 15:32-33 gives the same facts. Kings first dates Jotham's accession by the reign of Pekah king of Israel; Chronicles leaves that date out, as it leaves out the northern kings' dates throughout. Here Jotham is named in the sentence where Kings says "he", the verb "was" is left unspoken, and his mother's name is spelled with a final h (Jerushah; Kings has Jerusha). The account follows directly on Uzziah's death (26:23).

decisions.choice: a son of twenty-five years: twenty-five years old
decisions.reason: The usual Hebrew way of giving someone's age.

decisions.choice: Jerushah daughter of Zadok: the queen mother
decisions.reason: Like Kings, Chronicles names the mother of each king of Judah, who held a place of honor at court. This Zadok is not otherwise known; the text does not say whether he belonged to the priestly family of that name.

decisions.choice: Jerushah
decisions.reason: The name keeps the form this verse's spelling gives; 2 Kings 15:33 is rendered Jerusha because its Hebrew spelling ends differently.

decisions.choice: "Jerusa"
decisions.reason: The wording of Spanish 2 Kings 15:33 at each level. The two Hebrew spellings of the queen mother's name differ only in a final letter that Spanish does not write, so Spanish keeps "Jerusa" in both books.

decisions.choice: "Yerousha", as in French 2 Kings 15:33
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spelling here ends in a silent h that 2 Kings 15:33 lacks; French writes no final h on such names, so one form serves both verses.

decisions.choice: the Swahili of 2 Kings 15:33-38
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew is the same as Kings, each level keeps its Swahili of Kings; the queen mother keeps the Swahili form Yerusha, which covers both Hebrew spellings.

decisions.choice: "Giê-ru-sa con gái Xa-đốc", as 2 Kings 15:33
decisions.reason: The queen mother is spelled as in the 2 Kings drafts; the formula is reused from 2 Kings 15:33 (m1).

decisions.choice: "여루사" for Jerushah, the same Korean form as 2 Kings 15:33
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew spellings differ only in a final letter that Korean does not write (r-en-1), so the Kings form is kept; ages and years are in figures.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 15:33, with "Jotão" for "Ele"; Jerusa, filha de Zadoque
decisions.reason: The accession formula repeats 2 Kings 15:33 in Portuguese level by level, with the king named where Kings says "he" (m1). The English writes "Jerushah" here and "Jerusha" in Kings because the Hebrew spellings end differently; Portuguese already ends the name in "-a" and writes the same "Jerusa" in both books, as a reader would hear it.

source.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֜ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה כְּכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔יו רַ֕ק לֹא־בָ֖א אֶל־הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה וְע֥וֹד הָעָ֖ם מַשְׁחִיתִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh according to all that had done Uzziah his father; only not he went into [the] temple of Yahweh; and still the people [were] acting corruptly.

en.L: And he did the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to all that Uzziah his father had done; only he did not go into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. And the people were still acting corruptly.
en.B: He did what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as his father Uzziah had done, except that he did not go into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. But the people still behaved corruptly.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right, just as his father Uzziah had done. But he did not go into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the way his father had. The people, though, still did what was wrong.

es.L: E hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a todo lo que había hecho Uzías su padre; solo que no entró en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Y el pueblo todavía obraba con corrupción.
es.B: Hizo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como lo había hecho su padre Uzías, excepto que no entró en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Pero el pueblo seguía actuando con corrupción.
es.R: Hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, tal como lo había hecho su padre Uzías. Pero no entró en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, como lo había hecho su padre. El pueblo, sin embargo, seguía haciendo lo malo.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon tout ce qu’avait fait Ozias son père ; seulement, il n’entra pas dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Et le peuple agissait encore de façon corrompue.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, tout comme son père Ozias, sauf qu’il n’entra pas dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Mais le peuple continuait à se corrompre.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon, comme son père Ozias l’avait fait. Mais il n’est pas entré dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} comme son père l’avait fait. Le peuple, lui, continuait à faire le mal.

sw.L: Naye akafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na yote aliyoyafanya Uzia baba yake; ila hakuingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Na watu walikuwa bado wakitenda kwa upotovu.
sw.B: Alifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama baba yake Uzia alivyofanya, isipokuwa hakuingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Lakini watu waliendelea kutenda kwa upotovu.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema, kama baba yake Uzia alivyofanya. Lakini hakuingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama baba yake alivyofanya. Hata hivyo watu waliendelea kufanya mabaya.

vi.L: Vua làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo mọi điều Ô-xia cha vua đã làm; chỉ là vua không vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Còn dân chúng vẫn làm điều bại hoại.
vi.B: Vua làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đúng như Ô-xia cha vua đã làm, ngoại trừ việc vua không vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Nhưng dân chúng vẫn cư xử bại hoại.
vi.R: Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải, đúng như Ô-xia cha vua đã làm. Nhưng vua không vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như cha vua đã làm. Còn dân chúng thì vẫn làm điều sai trái.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 아버지 웃시야가 한 모든 일대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했다. 다만 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어가지 않았다. 그리고 백성은 여전히 악하게 행하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지 웃시야가 한 것처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했다. 다만 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에는 들어가지 않았다. 그러나 백성은 여전히 타락한 행동을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지 웃시야처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다. 그러나 그는 아버지처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 안에 들어가지는 않았다. 그런데 백성은 여전히 잘못된 일을 했다.

pt.L: E fez o reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, conforme tudo o que Uzias, seu pai, tinha feito; somente não entrou no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. E o povo ainda agia de modo corrupto.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, assim como o seu pai Uzias tinha feito, exceto que não entrou no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Mas o povo continuava a agir de modo corrupto.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava certo, assim como o seu pai Uzias tinha feito. Mas ele não entrou no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} como o seu pai tinha entrado. O povo, porém, continuava fazendo o que era errado.

decisions.choice: did the right in the eyes of Yahweh: the verdict of 2 Kings 15:34
decisions.reason: The words of the verdict are the same as in 2 Kings 15:34: Jotham did what was right, as his father Uzziah had. Chronicles then adds the two clauses that follow, which Kings does not have.

decisions.choice: only he did not go into the temple of Yahweh: unlike Uzziah
decisions.reason: "Only" limits the comparison with his father. Uzziah, made proud by his strength, went into the temple to burn incense, which only the priests could do, and was struck with a skin disease (26:16-21). Jotham followed his father's good ways but not that one.

decisions.choice: the temple: the sanctuary building itself
decisions.reason: The word names the main hall of the temple, where the altar of incense stood and only priests could enter (26:16), not the courts where the people worshiped.

decisions.choice: the people were still acting corruptly
decisions.reason: The verb means to act ruinously or corruptly. The text does not say what the people did. 2 Kings 15:35 says at this point that the high places were not removed and the people still sacrificed and burned incense there; Chronicles sums the matter up in one word. The corruption is the people's, set against their king's faithfulness.

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The verdict formula, as in 2 Kings 15:34.

decisions.choice: the way his father had
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the contrast that "only" points to (m2), since a new reader may not remember 26:16.

decisions.choice: the verdict of 2 Kings 15:34; agia de modo corrupto (L), continuava a agir de modo corrupto (B), continuava fazendo o que era errado (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 15:34 at each level (m1). The two clauses Chronicles adds are drafted from its Hebrew: the temple is "o templo", as at 26:16 (m3), and the people's ruinous conduct (m4) is "agir de modo corrupto", which leaves unsaid what they did, as the Hebrew does.

source.text: ה֗וּא בָּנָ֛ה אֶת־שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית־יְהוָ֖ה הָעֶלְי֑וֹן וּבְחוֹמַ֥ת הָעֹ֛פֶל בָּנָ֖ה לָרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: He built [the] gate of [the] house of Yahweh, the upper, and on [the] wall of the Ophel he built to abundance.

en.L: He built the upper gate of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and on the wall of the Ophel he built much.
en.B: He built the Upper Gate of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he did much building on the wall of Ophel.
en.R: Jotham built the Upper Gate of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He also did a great deal of building on the wall at the hill of Ophel.

es.L: Él edificó la puerta superior de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y sobre el muro del Ofel edificó mucho.
es.B: Él construyó la puerta Superior de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y edificó mucho en el muro del Ofel.
es.R: Jotam construyó la puerta Superior del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. También hizo muchas obras en el muro de la colina del Ofel.

fr.L: C’est lui qui bâtit la porte supérieure de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et sur la muraille de l’Ophel il bâtit beaucoup.
fr.B: C’est lui qui bâtit la porte Supérieure de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il fit de nombreux travaux sur la muraille de l’Ophel.
fr.R: C’est Jotham qui a construit la porte Supérieure du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il a aussi fait beaucoup de travaux sur la muraille de la colline de l’Ophel.

sw.L: Yeye alijenga lango la juu la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na juu ya ukuta wa Ofeli alijenga kwa wingi.
sw.B: Yeye alijenga Lango la Juu la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akafanya kazi kubwa ya ujenzi juu ya ukuta wa Ofeli.
sw.R: Yothamu alijenga Lango la Juu la hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Pia alifanya kazi kubwa ya ujenzi juu ya ukuta wa kilima cha Ofeli.

vi.L: Vua xây cổng trên của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và trên tường thành Ô-phên, vua xây cất nhiều.
vi.B: Vua xây Cổng Trên của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và xây cất nhiều trên tường thành Ô-phên.
vi.R: Giô-tham xây Cổng Trên của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua cũng xây cất nhiều trên tường thành ở đồi Ô-phên.

ko.L: 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 윗문을 건축했고, 오벨 성벽에 많이 건축했다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 윗문을 건축했고, 오벨 성벽도 많이 쌓았다.
ko.R: 요담은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전의 윗문을 지었다. 그는 또 오벨 언덕의 성벽도 많이 쌓았다.

pt.L: Ele edificou a porta superior da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e no muro do Ofel edificou muito.
pt.B: Ele construiu a Porta Superior da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e fez muitas obras no muro de Ofel.
pt.R: Jotão construiu a Porta Superior do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Também fez muitas obras no muro do monte Ofel.

decisions.choice: the upper gate of the house of Yahweh: as in 2 Kings 15:35
decisions.reason: This clause matches 2 Kings 15:35, where the gate is probably the north gate of the temple courts (Ezekiel 9:2; Jeremiah 20:2). Chronicles adds the work on the wall of Ophel.

decisions.choice: the Ophel: the ridge between the City of David and the temple
decisions.reason: The Ophel was the raised part of Jerusalem just south of the temple area, above the old City of David. Its wall was strengthened again by Manasseh (33:14), and the name comes back in Nehemiah 3:26-27.

decisions.choice: he built to abundance: he built a great deal
decisions.reason: The phrase means the amount of work was large, not that he built something called "much".

decisions.choice: Jotham; temple; the hill of Ophel
decisions.reason: Readable names Jotham for "he", says "temple" for "house" as 2 Kings 15:35 does, and calls Ophel a hill so the reader knows it is a place.

decisions.choice: "la puerta Superior"; "el Ofel"; "la colina del Ofel" (R)
decisions.reason: The gate as Spanish 2 Kings 15:35 names it; Readable calls Ophel a hill, as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 15:35: a porta superior (L), a Porta Superior (B, R); Ofel (o monte Ofel, R)
decisions.reason: The gate keeps the words of 2 Kings 15:35 in Portuguese at each level (m1). The place takes the Portuguese form "Ofel" (m2), with the article at Literal as the Hebrew has it, and Readable calls it "o monte Ofel" so that the reader knows it is a hill, as the English does.

source.text: וְעָרִ֥ים בָּנָ֖ה בְּהַר־יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבֶחֳרָשִׁ֣ים בָּנָ֔ה בִּֽירָנִיּ֖וֹת וּמִגְדָּלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And cities he built in [the] hill country of Judah, and in the wooded heights he built fortresses and towers.

en.L: And cities he built in the hill country of Judah, and in the wooded areas he built fortresses and towers.
en.B: In the hill country of Judah he built cities, and in the wooded areas he put up fortresses and towers.
en.R: He built towns in the hills of Judah, and forts and lookout towers in the forests.

es.L: Y ciudades edificó en la región montañosa de Judá, y en los bosques edificó fortalezas y torres.
es.B: En la región montañosa de Judá edificó ciudades, y en las zonas boscosas levantó fortalezas y torres.
es.R: Construyó pueblos en los montes de Judá, y fortalezas y torres de vigilancia en los bosques.

fr.L: Et il bâtit des villes dans la région montagneuse de Juda, et dans les forêts il bâtit des forteresses et des tours.
fr.B: Il bâtit des villes dans la région montagneuse de Juda, et il construisit des forteresses et des tours dans les zones boisées.
fr.R: Il a construit des villages dans les collines de Juda, et des forts et des tours de guet dans les forêts.

sw.L: Na miji alijenga katika nchi ya milima ya Yuda, na katika maeneo ya misitu alijenga ngome na minara.
sw.B: Katika nchi ya milima ya Yuda alijenga miji, na katika maeneo ya misitu alijenga ngome na minara.
sw.R: Alijenga miji midogo katika milima ya Yuda, na ngome na minara ya ulinzi katika misitu.

vi.L: Vua xây các thành trong vùng đồi núi Giu-đa, và trong các vùng rừng, vua xây các đồn lũy và tháp canh.
vi.B: Vua xây các thành trong vùng đồi núi Giu-đa, và dựng các đồn lũy và tháp canh trong các vùng rừng.
vi.R: Vua xây các thị trấn trên những vùng đồi của Giu-đa, và xây đồn lũy và tháp canh trong rừng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 유다 산지에 성읍들을 건축했고, 숲 지대에 요새들과 망대들을 건축했다.
ko.B: 그는 유다 산지에 성읍들을 세우고, 숲이 우거진 곳에 요새들과 망대들을 세웠다.
ko.R: 그는 유다의 산지에 마을들을 세우고, 숲 속에 요새와 망보는 탑들을 세웠다.

pt.L: E cidades edificou na região montanhosa de Judá, e nos bosques edificou fortalezas e torres.
pt.B: Na região montanhosa de Judá ele construiu cidades, e nas áreas de bosque levantou fortalezas e torres.
pt.R: Ele construiu cidades nas montanhas de Judá, e fortes e torres de vigia nas florestas.

decisions.choice: wooded areas
decisions.reason: The word means a thicket or a wooded stretch of land, here the forested slopes on the edges of Judah's hill country, where small posts could watch the roads and the border.

decisions.choice: fortresses and towers: strongholds and watchtowers
decisions.reason: The word for fortresses is rare and found only in Chronicles (17:12, of Jehoshaphat's building). The towers would serve as lookouts and defenses. Uzziah had built towers in the same way (26:9-10); Jotham carries on his father's work. Building is one of the ways Chronicles shows a faithful king's strength.

decisions.choice: towns; lookout towers
decisions.reason: Readable says "towns", since these were small places, and "lookout towers" to show what the towers were for.

decisions.choice: cidades (R); torres de vigia (R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "cidade" covers a small walled town as well as a large one, so Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "towns"; "torres de vigia" says what the towers were for (m2), as at 26:10.

source.text: וְ֠הוּא נִלְחַ֞ם עִם־מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן֮ וַיֶּחֱזַ֣ק עֲלֵיהֶם֒ וַיִּתְּנוּ־ל֨וֹ בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֜וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַהִ֗יא מֵאָה֙ כִּכַּר־כֶּ֔סֶף וַעֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים כֹּרִים֙ חִטִּ֔ים וּשְׂעוֹרִ֖ים עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים זֹ֗את הֵשִׁ֤יבוּ לוֹ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹןסוּבַשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית וְהַשְּׁלִשִֽׁית׃

records.literal_gloss: And he fought with [the] king of [the] sons of Ammon, and he was strong over them; and gave to him [the] sons of Ammon in the year the that one hundred talent[s] of silver and ten thousand cors of wheat, and barley ten thousand; this brought back to him [the] sons of Ammon also in the year the second and the third.

en.L: And he fought with the king of the sons of Ammon and prevailed over them, and the sons of Ammon gave him in that year 100 talents of silver and 10,000 cors of wheat, and of barley 10,000. This the sons of Ammon paid him also in the second year and the third.
en.B: He fought against the king of the Ammonites and defeated them. That year the Ammonites gave him {{units:about 7,500 pounds of silver|100 talents of silver}}, {{units:about 60,000 bushels|10,000 cors}} of wheat and {{units:about 60,000 bushels|10,000 cors}} of barley. The Ammonites paid him the same in the second and third years as well.
en.R: Jotham went to war against the king of the Ammonites and won. That year the Ammonites had to pay him {{units:about 7,500 pounds of silver|100 talents of silver}}, {{units:about 60,000 bushels|10,000 cors}} of wheat and {{units:about 60,000 bushels|10,000 cors}} of barley. They paid him the same amount for the next two years too.

es.L: Y peleó contra el rey de los hijos de Amón y prevaleció sobre ellos, y los hijos de Amón le dieron aquel año cien talentos de plata, y diez mil coros de trigo, y de cebada diez mil. Esto le pagaron los hijos de Amón también el segundo año y el tercero.
es.B: Peleó contra el rey de los amonitas y los venció. Aquel año los amonitas le dieron {{units:unos 3 400 kilos de plata|cien talentos de plata}}, {{units:unos 2 200 000 litros|diez mil coros}} de trigo y {{units:unos 2 200 000 litros|diez mil coros}} de cebada. Los amonitas le pagaron lo mismo también el segundo y el tercer año.
es.R: Jotam fue a la guerra contra el rey de los amonitas y ganó. Aquel año los amonitas tuvieron que pagarle {{units:unos 3 400 kilos de plata|cien talentos de plata}}, {{units:unos 2 200 000 litros|diez mil coros}} de trigo y {{units:unos 2 200 000 litros|diez mil coros}} de cebada. Le pagaron la misma cantidad durante los dos años siguientes.

fr.L: Et il combattit contre le roi des fils d’Ammon et l’emporta sur eux ; et les fils d’Ammon lui donnèrent cette année-là cent talents d’argent, et dix mille cors de froment, et d’orge dix mille. Voilà ce que les fils d’Ammon lui rapportèrent aussi la deuxième année et la troisième.
fr.B: Il fit la guerre au roi des Ammonites et les vainquit. Cette année-là, les Ammonites lui donnèrent {{units:environ 3,4 tonnes d’argent|cent talents d’argent}}, {{units:environ 2,2 millions de litres|dix mille cors}} de froment et {{units:environ 2,2 millions de litres|dix mille cors}} d’orge. Les Ammonites lui payèrent la même chose la deuxième et la troisième année.
fr.R: Jotham est parti en guerre contre le roi des Ammonites et il a gagné. Cette année-là, les Ammonites ont dû lui payer {{units:environ 3,4 tonnes d’argent|cent talents d’argent}}, {{units:environ 2,2 millions de litres|dix mille cors}} de blé et {{units:environ 2,2 millions de litres|dix mille cors}} d’orge. Ils lui ont payé la même chose pendant les deux années suivantes.

sw.L: Akapigana na mfalme wa wana wa Amoni, akawashinda, na wana wa Amoni wakampa mwaka ule talanta 100 za fedha, na kori 10,000 za ngano, na za shayiri 10,000. Hivi ndivyo wana wa Amoni walivyomlipa pia katika mwaka wa pili na wa tatu.
sw.B: Alipigana na mfalme wa Waamoni, akawashinda. Mwaka ule Waamoni walimpa {{units:karibu kilo 3,400 za fedha|talanta 100 za fedha}}, {{units:karibu lita milioni 2.2|kori 10,000}} za ngano na {{units:karibu lita milioni 2.2|kori 10,000}} za shayiri. Waamoni walimlipa vivyo hivyo katika mwaka wa pili na wa tatu pia.
sw.R: Yothamu alipigana vita na mfalme wa Waamoni, akashinda. Mwaka ule Waamoni walilazimika kumlipa {{units:karibu kilo 3,400 za fedha|talanta 100 za fedha}}, {{units:karibu lita milioni 2.2|kori 10,000}} za ngano na {{units:karibu lita milioni 2.2|kori 10,000}} za shayiri. Walimlipa kiasi hicho hicho kwa miaka miwili iliyofuata pia.

vi.L: Vua giao chiến với vua của con cháu Am-môn và thắng họ; năm ấy con cháu Am-môn nộp cho vua một trăm ta-lâng bạc, mười nghìn cô-rơ lúa mì và mười nghìn [cô-rơ] lúa mạch. Con cháu Am-môn cũng nộp cho vua số ấy vào năm thứ hai và năm thứ ba.
vi.B: Vua đánh vua người Am-môn và thắng họ. Năm ấy người Am-môn nộp cho vua {{units:khoảng 3.400 kg bạc|một trăm ta-lâng bạc}}, {{units:khoảng 2.200.000 lít|mười nghìn cô-rơ}} lúa mì và {{units:khoảng 2.200.000 lít|mười nghìn cô-rơ}} lúa mạch. Người Am-môn cũng nộp như vậy vào năm thứ hai và năm thứ ba.
vi.R: Giô-tham đánh vua người Am-môn và thắng. Năm ấy người Am-môn phải nộp cho vua {{units:khoảng 3.400 kg bạc|một trăm ta-lâng bạc}}, {{units:khoảng 2.200.000 lít|mười nghìn cô-rơ}} lúa mì và {{units:khoảng 2.200.000 lít|mười nghìn cô-rơ}} lúa mạch. Hai năm sau đó họ cũng phải nộp chừng ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 암몬 자손의 왕과 싸워 그들을 이겼다. 그리고 그해에 암몬 자손이 그에게 은 100달란트와 밀 10,000고르와 보리 10,000[고르를] 바쳤다. 암몬 자손은 둘째 해와 셋째 해에도 이것을 그에게 바쳤다.
ko.B: 그는 암몬 사람들의 왕과 싸워 그들을 이겼다. 그해에 암몬 사람들은 그에게 {{units:약 3.4톤|100달란트}}에 이르는 은과 {{units:약 220만 리터|10,000고르}}의 밀과 {{units:약 220만 리터|10,000고르}}의 보리를 바쳤다. 암몬 사람들은 둘째 해와 셋째 해에도 그만큼 바쳤다.
ko.R: 요담은 암몬 사람들의 왕과 전쟁을 하여 이겼다. 그해에 암몬 사람들은 {{units:약 3.4톤|100달란트}}에 이르는 은과 {{units:약 220만 리터|10,000고르}}의 밀과 {{units:약 220만 리터|10,000고르}}의 보리를 그에게 바쳐야 했다. 그 뒤로 두 해 동안에도 그들은 그만큼 바쳤다.

pt.L: E ele lutou contra o rei dos filhos de Amom, e prevaleceu sobre eles; e os filhos de Amom lhe deram naquele ano cem talentos de prata, e dez mil coros de trigo, e de cevada dez mil. Isto os filhos de Amom lhe pagaram também no segundo ano e no terceiro.
pt.B: Ele guerreou contra o rei dos amonitas e os derrotou. Naquele ano os amonitas lhe deram {{units:cerca de 3,4 toneladas de prata|cem talentos de prata}}, {{units:cerca de 2,2 milhões de litros|dez mil coros}} de trigo e {{units:cerca de 2,2 milhões de litros|dez mil coros}} de cevada. Os amonitas lhe pagaram o mesmo também no segundo e no terceiro ano.
pt.R: Jotão foi à guerra contra o rei dos amonitas e venceu. Naquele ano os amonitas tiveram de lhe pagar {{units:cerca de 3,4 toneladas de prata|cem talentos de prata}}, {{units:cerca de 2,2 milhões de litros|dez mil coros}} de trigo e {{units:cerca de 2,2 milhões de litros|dez mil coros}} de cevada. Eles lhe pagaram a mesma quantia nos dois anos seguintes também.

decisions.choice: tribute from a defeated people
decisions.reason: The silver and grain were the price of defeat, paid by the Ammonites to the king of Judah. They had already paid tribute to Uzziah (26:8). A talent was a weight of about 75 pounds, and a cor a dry measure of about 6 bushels, so this was a very large payment.

decisions.choice: this they paid him also in the second year and the third: the same amount for two more years
decisions.reason: "This" refers back to the whole payment, and "brought back" is the usual word for paying what is owed. The second and third years are most naturally counted from the year of the victory. The text says nothing of later years, so the tribute may have stopped after that.

decisions.choice: barley ten thousand: ten thousand cors of barley
decisions.reason: The measure is not repeated with the barley but is understood from the wheat.

decisions.choice: the Ammonites
decisions.reason: "The sons of Ammon" is the name of the people. Literal keeps the Hebrew form; Balanced and Readable say "the Ammonites", as elsewhere in these books.

decisions.choice: 10,000 cors of barley
decisions.reason: The unit is repeated with the barley (m3) so the measure can be given in modern terms.

decisions.choice: "unos 3 400 kilos de plata" / "cien talentos"; "unos 2 200 000 litros" / "diez mil coros"
decisions.reason: The units setting converts the talent at 34 kg and the cor at 220 litres, as the terms note sets them, with the original units as the alternative; the cors are repeated with the barley, as the English does (m3).

decisions.choice: "environ 3,4 tonnes d'argent", "environ 2,2 millions de litres" / "cent talents", "dix mille cors"
decisions.reason: Metric by default in French (talent 34 kg, cor 220 litres, as the terms note sets), with the original units as the alternative; the English default is in pounds and bushels.

decisions.choice: karibu lita milioni 2.2 / kori 10,000
decisions.reason: Grain measures are given in litres by default (cor 220 litres), with the cors as the alternative; Literal keeps "kori".

decisions.choice: "khoảng 2.200.000 lít" for 10,000 cors, with "mười nghìn cô-rơ" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The terms note's cor of 220 litres; Vietnamese measures grain by volume in litres, where the English converts to bushels.

decisions.choice: Units spans "약 3.4톤" / "100달란트" and "약 220만 리터" / "10,000고르", each followed by a particle that fits both wordings ("에 이르는", "의")
decisions.reason: A cor is about 220 litres (terms note); the Korean metric alternative gives litres, as the 1 Kings drafts do for cors.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 3,4 toneladas de prata|cem talentos de prata}}, {{units:cerca de 2,2 milhões de litros|dez mil coros}} (B, R); cem talentos, dez mil coros (L)
decisions.reason: As 8:18 and 2:9 set the measures for the book in Portuguese: metric by default where the English gives pounds and bushels, at 34 kg to the talent and 220 litres to the cor, with the original units as the alternative; Literal keeps the talents and cors. The round numbers are written in words, where the English uses figures.

source.text: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֖ק יוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֚י הֵכִ֣ין דְּרָכָ֔יו לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And strengthened himself Jotham, because he made firm his ways before Yahweh his God.

en.L: And Jotham strengthened himself, because he made his ways firm before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God.
en.B: Jotham grew strong, because he kept his ways steady before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God.
en.R: Jotham became powerful because he took care to live the way {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God wanted.

es.L: Y Jotam se fortaleció, porque afirmó sus caminos delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.B: Jotam se hizo fuerte, porque mantuvo firmes sus caminos delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.R: Jotam llegó a ser poderoso porque procuró vivir como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios quería.

fr.L: Et Jotham s’affermit, parce qu’il affermit ses voies devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu.
fr.B: Jotham devint puissant, parce qu’il garda une conduite ferme devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu.
fr.R: Jotham est devenu puissant parce qu’il a pris soin de vivre comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu le voulait.

sw.L: Yothamu akajiimarisha, kwa sababu aliziimarisha njia zake mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake.
sw.B: Yothamu alipata nguvu, kwa sababu aliziweka njia zake imara mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake.
sw.R: Yothamu akawa na nguvu kwa sababu alijitahidi kuishi kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake alivyotaka.

vi.L: Giô-tham làm cho mình vững mạnh, vì vua giữ vững đường lối mình trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua.
vi.B: Giô-tham trở nên hùng mạnh, vì vua giữ đường lối mình vững vàng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua.
vi.R: Giô-tham trở nên hùng mạnh vì vua cẩn thận sống theo cách {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của vua, muốn.

ko.L: 그리고 요담이 강해졌다. 그가 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 그의 길들을 굳게 했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 요담은 점점 강해졌다. 그가 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 자기의 길을 바르게 지켰기 때문이다.
ko.R: 요담은 강한 왕이 되었다. 그의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 원하시는 대로 살려고 늘 애썼기 때문이다.

pt.L: E Jotão se fortaleceu, porque firmou os seus caminhos diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus.
pt.B: Jotão se tornou forte, porque manteve firmes os seus caminhos diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o seu Deus.
pt.R: Jotão ficou poderoso porque teve o cuidado de viver como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, queria.

decisions.choice: strengthened himself: grew strong, became firmly established
decisions.reason: The verb form describes a king gaining strength and a secure hold on his kingdom, as Solomon did (1:1). The building and the victory of verses 3-5 show what that strength was.

decisions.choice: made his ways firm: kept his conduct steady and directed
decisions.reason: The verb means to set firm or to set in order. Jotham's ways, that is, the way he lived and ruled, were held on a steady course "before" Yahweh, in his sight and as answerable to him.

decisions.choice: because: faithfulness as the reason for strength
decisions.reason: Chronicles often ties a king's success to his seeking God (26:5). With Uzziah, strength led to pride and his fall (26:16); with Jotham, faithfulness is the cause of his strength, and no fall is told.

decisions.choice: took care to live the way the LORD his God wanted
decisions.reason: Readable puts "made his ways firm before" into plain words. It keeps the sense of steady, deliberate living without naming particular acts.

decisions.choice: firmou os seus caminhos (L); manteve firmes os seus caminhos (B)
decisions.reason: "Caminhos" is the Old Testament word for a person's conduct, kept at Literal and Balanced (m2); "firmar" and "manter firmes" give the verb's sense of setting a steady course. Readable says it in plain words, as the English does.

source.text: וְיֶתֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יוֹתָ֔ם וְכָל־מִלְחֲמֹתָ֖יו וּדְרָכָ֑יו הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Jotham and all his wars and his ways, look, they [are] written on [the] book of [the] kings of Israel and Judah.

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, look, they [are] written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
en.B: The rest of the acts of Jotham, with all his wars and his ways, are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
en.R: Everything else Jotham did, including all his wars and the way he lived, is written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Jotam, y todas sus guerras y sus caminos, he aquí [están] escritos en el libro de los reyes de Israel y de Judá.
es.B: Los demás hechos de Jotam, con todas sus guerras y sus caminos, están escritos en el libro de los Reyes de Israel y de Judá.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Jotam, incluidas todas sus guerras y su manera de vivir, está escrito en el libro de los reyes de Israel y de Judá.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Jotham, et toutes ses guerres, et ses voies, voici, ils [sont] écrits dans le livre des rois d’Israël et de Juda.
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Jotham, avec toutes ses guerres et sa conduite, est écrit dans le livre des Rois d’Israël et de Juda.
fr.R: Tout ce que Jotham a fait d’autre, avec toutes ses guerres et sa manière de vivre, a été écrit dans le livre des rois d’Israël et de Juda.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yothamu, na vita vyake vyote na njia zake, tazama, yameandikwa katika kitabu cha wafalme wa Israeli na Yuda.
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yothamu, pamoja na vita vyake vyote na njia zake, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Wafalme wa Israeli na Yuda.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Yothamu, pamoja na vita vyake vyote na jinsi alivyoishi, yameandikwa katika kitabu cha wafalme wa Israeli na Yuda.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giô-tham, mọi cuộc chiến và đường lối của vua, kìa, đã được chép trong sách các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa.
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giô-tham, cùng mọi cuộc chiến và đường lối của vua, đều được chép trong Sách Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Giô-tham đã làm, kể cả mọi cuộc chiến và cách vua sống, đều được chép trong sách các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 요담의 나머지 일들과 그의 모든 전쟁과 그의 길들은, 보아라, 이스라엘과 유다 왕들의 책에 기록되어 있다.
ko.B: 요담의 나머지 행적과 그가 치른 모든 전쟁과 그가 걸어간 길은 이스라엘과 유다 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 요담이 한 다른 모든 일, 곧 그가 치른 모든 전쟁과 그가 살아간 모습은 이스라엘과 유다 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Jotão, e todas as suas guerras e os seus caminhos, eis que estão escritos no livro dos reis de Israel e de Judá.
pt.B: Os demais atos de Jotão, com todas as suas guerras e os seus caminhos, estão escritos no Livro dos Reis de Israel e de Judá.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Jotão fez, incluindo todas as suas guerras e o modo como viveu, está escrito no livro dos reis de Israel e de Judá.

decisions.choice: the sources formula, in Chronicles' form; parallel to 2 Kings 15:36
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 15:36 asks, "are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah?" Chronicles makes it a statement, adds "all his wars and his ways", and names "the book of the kings of Israel and Judah". At 16:11 the same kind of title has the names in the other order; it seems to be the same record, a fuller account that is not part of the Bible.

decisions.choice: all his wars: more than the one told
decisions.reason: Only the Ammonite war is told (verse 5). Chronicles does not repeat the attacks of Rezin and Pekah that began in Jotham's days (2 Kings 15:37); it tells of that war under Ahaz (28:5-8).

decisions.choice: look, they are written: pointing the reader to the record
decisions.reason: The pointing word draws attention to where the record can be found, as in 16:11.

decisions.choice: "look" left out; the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah (Balanced); the book of the kings of Israel and Judah (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 16:11: Balanced and Readable carry the pointing word by the plain statement, Balanced writes the source as a title, and Readable keeps it plain. "His ways" becomes "the way he lived" at Readable.

decisions.choice: eis que estão escritos (L); o livro dos reis de Israel e de Judá (L, R), o Livro dos Reis de Israel e de Judá (B)
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps the words 16:11 sets for it in Portuguese, the pointing "eis que" at Literal (m3) and the title with capitals at Balanced, here with Israel named first, as the Hebrew has it. Chronicles makes 2 Kings 15:36's question a statement (m1), so no level asks it.

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְחָמֵ֛שׁ שָׁנָ֖ה הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֑וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of twenty and five year[s] he was when he became king, and six-teen year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem.

en.L: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem.
en.B: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
en.R: He was twenty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years.

es.L: Tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y dieciséis años reinó en Jerusalén.
es.B: Tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó dieciséis años en Jerusalén.
es.R: Tenía veinticinco años cuando llegó a ser rey, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante dieciséis años.

fr.L: Il avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Il avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna seize ans à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Il avait vingt-cinq ans quand il est devenu roi. Il a régné à Jérusalem pendant seize ans.

sw.L: [Alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, na miaka kumi na sita alitawala huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na sita huko Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na sita.

vi.L: Vua [được] hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì mười sáu năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vua được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười sáu năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Vua được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mười sáu năm.

ko.L: 그가 왕이 되었을 때 25세였고, 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 그는 25세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 그는 25세에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 16년 동안 다스렸다.

pt.L: Ele tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e dezesseis anos reinou em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Ele tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou dezesseis anos em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Ele tinha vinte e cinco anos quando se tornou rei. Governou em Jerusalém durante dezesseis anos.

decisions.choice: the verse repeats verse 1, and is kept as the Hebrew text has it
decisions.reason: This verse gives again the age and length of reign from verse 1, here with "he was" as in 2 Kings 15:33, and without the mother's name. It may close the account of the reign, framing it before the death notice, or an early copyist may have written the line twice. The Hebrew text has it, and it is translated.

decisions.choice: the same wording as 2 Kings 15:33
decisions.reason: The Hebrew matches 2 Kings 15:33 word for word in this part, so its wording is reused at each level.

decisions.choice: the same wording as Spanish 2 Kings 15:33
decisions.reason: The Hebrew matches 2 Kings 15:33 word for word in this part, so its Spanish is reused at each level.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 15:33
decisions.reason: The verse repeats verse 1 with "he was", word for word as 2 Kings 15:33 (m1), so it keeps that verse's Portuguese at each level, without the mother's name.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹתָם֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Jotham with his fathers, and they buried him in [the] city of David, and reigned Ahaz his son in his place.

en.L: And Jotham lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David, and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Jotham rested with his ancestors, and they buried him in the City of David. His son Ahaz became king in his place.
en.R: Then Jotham died and was buried in the City of David. His son Ahaz became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Jotam con sus padres, y lo sepultaron en la ciudad de David; y reinó en su lugar Acaz su hijo.
es.B: Luego Jotam descansó con sus antepasados, y lo sepultaron en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Acaz reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Luego Jotam murió y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Acaz lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Jotham se coucha avec ses pères, et on l’enterra dans la cité de David ; et Achaz son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Jotham reposa avec ses ancêtres, et on l’enterra dans la cité de David. Son fils Achaz régna à sa place.
fr.R: Ensuite Jotham est mort et il a été enterré dans la cité de David. Son fils Achaz est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Naye Yothamu akalala pamoja na baba zake, wakamzika katika mji wa Daudi; na Ahazi mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Yothamu alipumzika pamoja na babu zake, wakamzika katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Ahazi akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Yothamu alikufa, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Ahazi akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Giô-tham nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và người ta chôn vua trong thành Đa-vít; A-cha con trai vua trị vì thay vua.
vi.B: Rồi Giô-tham an giấc cùng tổ tiên, và người ta chôn vua trong thành Đa-vít. A-cha con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Rồi Giô-tham qua đời và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít. A-cha con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 요담이 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 사람들이 그를 다윗 성에 묻었다. 그리고 그의 아들 아하스가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 요담은 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 사람들은 그를 다윗 성에 묻었다. 그의 아들 아하스가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 요담은 죽었고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아하스가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Jotão descansou com os seus pais, e o sepultaram na Cidade de Davi, e Acaz, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Então Jotão descansou com os seus antepassados, e o sepultaram na Cidade de Davi. E o seu filho Acaz reinou em seu lugar.
pt.R: Então Jotão morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados. Ele foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi. O seu filho Acaz se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula: he died and joined his ancestors in death.

decisions.choice: they buried him in the City of David: shorter than 2 Kings 15:38
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 15:38 says he "was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father". Chronicles says "they buried him in the City of David". Unlike his father Uzziah, who was buried apart because of his skin disease (26:23), Jotham is buried in the royal city with nothing to set him apart.

decisions.choice: Ahaz his son: the next king of Judah
decisions.reason: His reign is told in chapter 28.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula has one wording at each level. Readable says "was buried" for "they buried him"; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the death formula of 2 Kings 15:38, shortened; Acaz
decisions.reason: The death formula keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 15:38 at each level, with Readable's "foi descansar com os seus antepassados" as 16:13 sets it for the book; Chronicles says only "they buried him in the City of David" (m2), so "com os seus pais" and "seu pai" after the city are left out, and Literal and Balanced say "o sepultaram". The next king is "Acaz", as in Kings (m3).
